text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear me, everyone! In this floor-wiping 
tournament, 
we shall surely emerge victorious~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Though here we go again, 
another of Tracen Academy's bizarre 
events. 
Stuff like this happens all the time, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. If I recall, this time it is 
a joint project 
between the Beautification and Morals 
Committees.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Diligently cleaning while observing the 
rules— 
It certainly reflects aspects of both, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin the floor-wiping 
tournament! 
The condition for victory is polishing the 
floor 
to the 'most beautiful' shine! Ready, set, 
go♪

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: 'Most beautiful'...—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ho? Not 'fastest'... 
In that case, simply wiping won't be 
enough to win.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We will require a strategy. 
Starting with the fundamentals, perhaps 
dividing the work? 
Given the vastness of the area.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Totally. And maybe wiping it wet, then 
dry? 
Doing both will leave it super clean, 
right?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Right. Then, keeping all of that 
in mind—shall we begin!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Phew...!  
Um... we've finished wiping down our side!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Same here!  
Dry-cloth squad, you're up next!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm, leave it to us! Let us make haste, 
Lady Phalaeno! 
Now is the time to show our true mettle—!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us polish it to perfection— 
so it shines most beautifully!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My... the floor is positively gleaming! 
Compared to the other teams, the 
difference is night and day. 
The winners are—your team!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! Victory is ours! 
Raise the victory cry, everyone—!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So ours was the cleanest of all... 
That is what it means, then. Hehe, how 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, that feels surprisingly satisfying. 
"The cleanest of all," huh? Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. And this victory, seized together 
by all of us— 
...fills me with pride. Truly.

Perhaps it was thanks to that victory, 
for ever since that day, Phalaenopsis's 
running 
had grown even sharper.
